build_patch_embed_layer: build a PatchEmbed layer to convert 2D images into patch embeddings with configurable patch size
create_patch_embed_with_norm: create a PatchEmbed layer with a normalization layer applied after the convolutional projection
test_patch_embed_forward: test the PatchEmbed forward pass by passing an image tensor and verifying output shape
review_patch_embed_init_img_size: review the PatchEmbed _init_img_size method to understand how grid size and num_patches are computed
refactor_patch_embed_bias: refactor the PatchEmbed class to toggle bias on or off in the convolutional projection layer
